name: mini-button
purpose: Compact text action with an optional trailing external-link icon and a ghost hover surface. Use for secondary CTAs in dense layouts (cards, tables, toolbars) where a full `Button` is too heavy. Differs from `navigation/link` by using default body text color and a brand-colored icon.
useWhen: A short secondary CTA ("Learn more") inside a card, feature tile or table where a full `button` is too heavy.
A marketing link that reads in body text color with a brand-colored icon.
avoidWhen: A standalone navigation link in product UI (a domain, a repository, a docs page) → use `link`.
The main action of a section → use `button`.
A link inside a sentence → use a plain anchor with the text-link class.
related: link` — same anatomy (label, trailing icon, ghost hover) in link color, with a `small` size; the default for standalone links.
button` — full action control with kinds, loading and a button element; `kind="link"` with a trailing icon covers the same text action.
Overlap: MiniButton is always an anchor with a trailing icon, the anatomy of `link`. Prefer `link` for new code; MiniButton stays for the marketing surfaces that use its body-colored label.
bestPractices: Always set `href`; the default `'#'` is a placeholder and the control always renders as an anchor.
Replace the `'Learn more'` default `label` with text that says where the link goes.

Keep the default `pi pi-external-link` icon for off-site targets with `target="_blank"` (`rel="noopener noreferrer"` is added for you); set `icon` to an empty string otherwise (`showIcon` is deprecated).

props.name: label
props.doc: Visible label rendered inside the control. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Learn more`).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects height, gap, and typography.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: showIcon
props.doc: @deprecated since 6.0 — set icon to an empty string. Removed in 7.0.` False hides the icon.

props.name: icon
props.doc: PrimeIcons class for the trailing icon. Empty renders no icon.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import MiniButton from '@aziontech/webkit/mini-button'
</script>

<template>
  <MiniButton
    size="large"
    label="Learn more"
    href="https://example.com/docs"
  />
</template>

Disabled
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import MiniButton from '@aziontech/webkit/mini-button'
</script>

<template>
  <MiniButton
    label="Read the docs"
    href="https://example.com/docs"
    disabled
  />
</template>
